description.en: Comprehensive foundational year in IT, covering the core principles of software development, networking, operating systems, databases, security and project management. Built various practical applications using Java, Python and web technologies and gained experience with Spring Boot, MySQL, Firebase and IoT. Learned to work with Agile methods, version control (Git) and gained exposure to full-stack development.
description.pt: Ano fundamental abrangente em TI, cobrindo os princípios básicos de desenvolvimento de software, redes, sistemas operativos, bases de dados, segurança e gestão de projetos. Construí várias aplicações práticas usando Java, Python e tecnologias web e ganhei experiência com Spring Boot, MySQL, Firebase e IoT. Aprendi a trabalhar com métodos Ágeis, controlo de versões (Git) e obtive exposição ao desenvolvimento full-stack.
description.de: Umfassendes Grundlagenjahr in der IT, das die Kernprinzipien der Softwareentwicklung, Netzwerke, Betriebssysteme, Datenbanken, Sicherheit und Projektmanagement abdeckt. Verschiedene praktische Anwendungen mit Java, Python und Webtechnologien erstellt und Erfahrungen mit Spring Boot, MySQL, Firebase und IoT gesammelt. Agile Methoden und Versionskontrolle (Git) erlernt und Einblicke in die Full-Stack-Entwicklung gewonnen.

description.en: Worked on two major internal projects: MediStock, a full-stack material reservation tool developed with React and Flask and SalesChamp, a B2B-focused CRM enhancement. Focused on frontend development, state management, database design and implementing secure user interactions. Collaborated with designers, backend engineers and business stakeholders in an agile, fast-paced environment. I also worked closely with [@Neo Stutz](https://neo.sunrise-avengers.ch/) and participated in many 'Schnupper Tage' and other outreach events with children interested in our profession. I also had a great time working and learning alongside my fellow apprentices [@Nik Brönnimann](https://nik.sunrise-avengers.ch/), [@Bareth Balakanthan](https://bareth.sunrise-avengers.ch/) and [@Simon Schiller](https://simon.sunrise-avengers.ch/). Together we built, learned and laughed, and even made our own site at [@Digital Avengers Lab](https://sunrise-avengers.ch).

description.en: During this time, I built a standalone Raspberry Pi router and access point, completely air-gapped, serving a local web portal via custom domains and reverse-proxy rules. I also wrote Bash scripts to continuously ping multiple PCs, funneling those performance metrics into InfluxDB and crafting real-time Grafana dashboards that show per-machine uptime, latency, and bandwidth. If any machine went offline, automated alerting would fire off an email to the administrator. On the network side, I designed and implemented a dual-zone architecture behind a firewall to keep development and operations traffic isolated and secure.
description.pt: Durante este período, construí um router e ponto de acesso Raspberry Pi autónomo, completamente isolado da rede externa, a servir um portal web local via domínios personalizados e regras de reverse-proxy. Também escrevi scripts Bash para fazer ping continuamente a múltiplos PCs, canalizando essas métricas de desempenho para o InfluxDB e criando dashboards Grafana em tempo real com uptime, latência e largura de banda por máquina. Se alguma máquina ficasse offline, alertas automáticos enviavam um e-mail ao administrador. No lado da rede, projetei e implementei uma arquitetura de zona dupla por trás de uma firewall para manter o tráfego de desenvolvimento e operações isolado e seguro.
description.de: In dieser Zeit baute ich einen eigenständigen Raspberry Pi Router und Access Point, vollständig isoliert, der ein lokales Webportal über benutzerdefinierte Domains und Reverse-Proxy-Regeln bereitstellt. Ich schrieb auch Bash-Skripte, um mehrere PCs kontinuierlich zu pingen, die Leistungsdaten in InfluxDB einzuspeisen und Echtzeit-Grafana-Dashboards mit Uptime, Latenz und Bandbreite pro Maschine zu erstellen. Bei einem Ausfall wurden automatisch E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen an den Administrator gesendet. Auf der Netzwerkseite entwarf ich eine Dual-Zone-Architektur hinter einer Firewall, um Entwicklungs- und Betriebsverkehr isoliert und sicher zu halten.

description.en: Currently responsible for multiple KPI dashboards under the CIO, providing data-driven insights across the organization. Manage the monthly data upload process to ensure dashboards remain accurate and up to date. The entire infrastructure runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), giving me hands-on experience with Google Cloud Storage (Buckets), Cloud Instances and broader GCP services.

Giro o processo mensal de carregamento de dados para garantir que os dashboards se mantêm precisos e atualizados. Toda a infraestrutura corre no Google Cloud Platform (GCP), dando-me experiência prática com Google Cloud Storage (Buckets), Cloud Instances e serviços GCP em geral.

Verwalte den monatlichen Daten-Upload-Prozess, um die Genauigkeit und Aktualität der Dashboards sicherzustellen. Die gesamte Infrastruktur läuft auf der Google Cloud Platform (GCP) und gibt mir praktische Erfahrung mit Google Cloud Storage, Cloud-Instanzen und weiteren GCP-Diensten.
